deals.headline: Bulk deal: 39.7 lakh shares @ Rs 169.60 on NSE (most recent on record; buyer/seller undisclosed)

news.headline: 20th AGM: shareholders approve FY26 financials, Goenka reappointment, auditor appointment
Independent director Rajeev RA resigns effective Sep 25, 2026; no other material reasons cited
Goenka Family Trust pledges 1.66 cr shares with Authum Investment; promoter-group encumbrance at 8.33 cr shares
Q1 FY27: sales Rs 110.8 cr, net loss Rs 1.3 cr; operating margin ~21%
FY26 results: PAT Rs 27 cr (vs Rs -118 cr), revenue Rs 1,593 cr (+108%), debt cut Rs 1,136 cr to Rs 746 cr; unmodified audit opinion
Unit to buy Radius Estates; receives LoA for Goa convention centre and Dona Paula projects
